description: Implement merchant policy compiler and simulation (Task 10) in packages/merchant-policy/. Build typed policy configuration covering product/category, INR currency, quantity/count, India destination, operating window, freshness, payment path, review, cancellation, and refund rules. Compile to MerchantPolicyConstraints from @counter/policy. Render deterministic plain-language summaries. Simulate representative Wallet authorities and reject ambiguous/invalid rule sets. Test buyer/merchant intersection and policy rollback/version behavior.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with no type errors in packages/merchant-policy
pnpm --filter @counter/merchant-policy test passes with all new tests green
Compiler correctly maps all 10+ rule types to MerchantPolicyConstraints fields
Summary renderer produces deterministic output (same input always same output)
Simulation correctly computes bilateral intersection via @counter/policy engine
Invalid/ambiguous rule sets are rejected with appropriate CanonicalError codes
Policy rollback detection correctly identifies version regression
findings: All 7 review issues addressed: tenant isolation, recursive payload hashing, manifest cross-check in health evaluator, engine-strict restored, idempotency store TTL/max-size, prefix-based simulation filter, and policy version-conflict detection via If-Match/ETag.
